title: Printable Christmas Card | Father Christmas Bicycle, Traditional Christmas Card, Instant Digital Download
description:
Send warm Christmas wishes with a card that feels full of winter evening charm. This cheerful illustrated scene brings a cosy, heartfelt note to the season. ✨

The Father Christmas on the Night Shift collection captures a joyful midnight city street, lit by golden shop lights against a blue night glow. Rich texture, a contemporary gouache look and a warmly nostalgic palette of cobalt, cranberry, cream, gold and spruce give the card a festive editorial feel.

The design

Father Christmas on the Night Shift shows a friendly Father Christmas cycling briskly through the city in a cranberry coat and cream-trimmed hat. His bicycle basket and rear rack are piled with wrapped parcels and a small evergreen sprig, while snowy rooftops, a crescent moon and looping golden fairy lights brighten the street. The open cobalt sky carries the Merry Christmas greeting. 🎄

How it works

Download the ZIP, choose your preferred format, then print, trim and fold your card using the included printing guide. Your Christmas wishes are ready to share. ❄️

A lovely choice when you want to send a thoughtful seasonal greeting with a little extra warmth and character. May it help make a Christmas message feel especially joyful.
